svg.text: cribsheet retrieval: index side and lookup side
Within a project, signals fuse dense-dominant: raw cosine + β·minmax(BM25). Across projects, rankings fuse with RRF.
dashed = derived, rebuilt on demand, dropped on write

text.tspan: key on it, so changing WINDOW_WORDS invalidates
only the cheap layer: windows, embeddings, tokens.
_lexical_tf · tokenize(heading ⊕ body) + _subtokens(camelCase, snake_case) @ w=1.0 · plus keyword terms @ w=keyword_weight
BM25 · k1=1.5 · b=0.75 · idf(t) = log(1 + (N − df + 0.5)/(df + 0.5)) always positive · doclen = Σ weighted term mass
MAX cosine per section, over its aliases
always on for code · OFF by default for notes

svg.text: an alias embedding points at its own section — the section's dense score is the max over its vectors, so an alias can only raise it

text.tspan: dense cosine stays RAW — it is already
calibrated, so a confident dense match
happened in the gate, before this norm.

svg.text: rerank top-N: order by minmax(fusion) + minmax(reranker)
additive, not authoritative — the reranker votes with fusion. Tail beyond N unchanged.
dedupe: section | file | none → ranked hits

text.tspan: code lookup fans out to the project's .crib refs:
each project ranked independently by the flow at left,
then the per-project rankings are RRF-fused.
EQUAL weights, deliberately: RRF is rank-based, so a damped weight
would bury refs beneath any full local top-k. Equal weights let a ref's
best hit beat a local mid-ranker; queried project first breaks ties local.
